# laug: laug cell health -block 2
# lease: absent
# compare: line cells/health.sh
[[ '7253' =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "laug · make cell-health: FRONTEND_PORT="'7253'" is not a whole number" >&2; exit 2; };  [[ '9110' =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "laug · make cell-health: PROMETHEUS_PORT="'9110'" is not a whole number" >&2; exit 2; };            
CELL_ADDRESS='127.0.0.1:7253' NAMESPACE=default PROM_URL='http://127.0.0.1:9110' cells/health.sh
